page.notes: Doubtful readings: "titul[?]" in the line "in titul de" is probably "titulo" or "tituli"; the word is damaged in print. The line "misericordiam hanc relativam" ends with the hyphenated "re-" which continues as "lativam" on the next line. The running head and page number are read from the scan. The decorative capitals A and P are read as A and P. "jul'us" at the end of "justus" is written as "justus". Long s is transcribed as s throughout.
